scope: Release payload, cache graph and launcher checks on Linux. Not a macOS GUI test.

tests.name: Every static JS dependency and CSS entry carries the current content fingerprint
All prebuilt payloads match the distributed build manifest
Launchers parse as Bash and server/updater scripts parse under Python 3.9 grammar
Actual START_MAC.command from an unrelated working directory serves v3.6.2 on its new port
An occupied default port cannot silently reopen the old game
Python launcher rejects a mixed/corrupted prebuilt renderer before serving it
Node launcher rejects a mixed/corrupted prebuilt renderer before serving it
